scope.transfer_note: Wikipedia passage surface rules can transfer to similar title-centric retrieval/evidence pipelines such as HotpotQA once its active feature tree is migrated.
scope.prompt_surface_note: Prompt text renders Wikipedia passage/source rules only; task-protocol and output-contract rules live in separate feature families.

paper_dataset_characteristics: HoVer uses English Wikipedia articles/passages for many-hop evidence verification.
Local benchmark overview notes HoVer and HotpotQA share a Wikipedia passage/source family but differ in output/task view.
Source semantic matrix records title alias/disambiguator annotations for wikipedia_passage_retrieval.
failure_patterns: Retrieval queries drift by repeating already-grounded text instead of preserving missing title-like evidence.
Summaries lose passage-title provenance, aliases, disambiguators, or year terms needed by later hops.
Unrelated passages get blended into evidence summaries instead of marked irrelevant.

payload.content:
Use these Wikipedia passage source rules when relevant:
- Treat article titles, aliases, parentheticals, work titles, proper nouns, dates, and disambiguators as source evidence.
- Preserve title heads and disambiguators when multiple Wikipedia pages can match the same surface form.
- Keep years as standalone evidence/query terms when they disambiguate an entity, event, publication, or corpus-time fact.
- Preserve passage titles or entity labels in summaries when they explain why a passage is relevant.
- Prefer compact title-like terms plus one relation anchor over long natural-language clauses when forming retrieval queries.
- Mark no-overlap passages as irrelevant instead of blending unrelated passage text into the evidence summary.
Apply these source rules only when the passage/corpus surface matches. If a rule conflicts with explicit prompt wording or evidence, follow the explicit wording and evidence. Do not change the required output format.

Use these Wikipedia passage source rules when relevant:
- Treat passage titles as evidence and preserve title matches, aliases, parentheticals, disambiguators, proper nouns, and dates in the summary.
- Prefix key evidence with the passage title or entity label when useful for later hops.
- Preserve relation anchors that connect the passage to the claim or question, such as directed, founded, located in, sibling, spouse, released, won, member of, or occupation.
- If a passage clarifies or corrects a title, spelling, alias, or date, preserve that corrected surface explicitly.
- Keep explicit years when they disambiguate source evidence or corpus-time facts.
- Mark no-overlap passages as irrelevant instead of blending them into the evidence summary.
Apply these source rules only when the passage/corpus surface matches. If a rule conflicts with explicit prompt wording or evidence, follow the explicit wording and evidence. Do not change the required output format.
